policy: Requirements proven to be solely Worldgroup-owned are excluded from MajorMUD parity. Mixed requirements retain only the MajorMUD-owned portion.

exact MajorMUD command confirmation behavior and target/player visibility
MajorMUD sysop-command audit logging where enabled by WCCMMUD.INI
MajorMUD save timing and world-state mutation ordering for sysop actions
native MajorMUD remote-action authority and exact failure messages
security-permissions: exact MajorMUD command-key authorization checks at the Worldgroup key handoff
native script and textblock execution privilege inside MajorMUD
remote-action authorization and caller identity inside MajorMUD
MajorMUD save/file and cross-character game-data access boundary
native command sanitization/rendering and exact unauthorized-action messages
logging-diagnostics: exact MajorMUD log destinations and WCCMMUD.INI-controlled log behavior
MajorMUD log retention/rotation and original module log formats
MajorMUD sysop audit visibility and redaction
startup-shutdown: exact MajorMUD module initialization and teardown ordering
MajorMUD clean-shutdown versus crash-recovery save behavior
pending MajorMUD action disposition during module shutdown/restart
account-session-ownership: duplicate character login and session-takeover behavior exposed to MajorMUD
linkdead grace period, idle/combat logout restrictions and safe-room restrictions
last-login persistence and exact MajorMUD login/logout messages
save ordering on disconnect plus party/follower cleanup ordering
world-rules-configuration: exact MajorMUD 1.11p configuration sources, defaults and allowed ranges
which MajorMUD settings are runtime mutable and which require module restart

MajorMUD world-state/save effects of starting room, starting wealth/level, experience, loot, respawn, PvP, death penalty, reset, Evil Point, communication, merchant/trainer, limited-item, quest and event settings
MajorMUD WCCMMUD.INI command-key settings and game-rule boundaries
help-reference: exact Classic MajorMUD help topic record families
native HELP syntax/aliases, formatting and pagination
MajorMUD textblock/help linkage and permission filtering
MajorMUD help search matching and ambiguity behavior
reforged-extension-boundaries: exact native Classic MajorMUD extension boundary and version markers
MajorMUD module feature flags that distinguish Classic behavior from Reforged extensions

evidence.claim: MajorMUD is installed and entered as a module under Worldgroup; Worldgroup server setup/security exists outside the MajorMUD game module.
Worldgroup security keys and the WCCMMUD.INI SYS_*_KEY settings form a host-to-module authorization handoff rather than multiple intrinsic MajorMUD administrator levels.
Official MajorMUD help documents MajorMUD-owned game commands, parties, gangs, communication, saving-on-exit and other in-realm behavior separately from the surrounding BBS login/menu layer.
